claim: Development-only official XML provenance inspection and bounded critical-field parity with already consumed MITAB evidence. Not biological truth, study-independence certification, a reserved result or full cross-format fidelity.

release.format: PSI-MI XML 2.5.4 as declared by official release README
release.selection_reason: Directory metadata lists October24 exports matching the MITAB family date better than PSI3 October18. Timestamps do not prove equal contents; exact identity/field parity is measured and differences remain visible.
release.requests: One exact HTTPS GET per allowlisted publication; no redirects, retries, ZIPs, replacement, source switching or reserved queries.

access.before_selected_access: Freeze this contract, synthetic control inventory and passing controls, code, class files, JARs, JVM, original MITAB reference pins and exact URLs in pre_access.json; prepare does not fetch or decode selected XML.
access.retrieval: Require explicit pre_access SHA; preserve retrieval-start receipt, bounded opaque bytes/hash, HTTP headers, and exposure-start receipt before invoking official XML parser. Failure remains consumed and is not replaced.
access.reserved_final: No body access, hashing, parsing or queries for any reserved study. No glob over opaque_sources.
access.xml_parser: Official PSI-JAMI jami-xml/core 3.9.4 ExtendedPsiXml interaction-evidence APIs only. No custom biological XML parser. External entities/DTDs/network resolvers disabled. No network schema validation.
access.all_failures: Keep failed controls, partial source/reader streams, terminal diagnostics and failure reports in exclusive new output directories.

preserve: Every experiment and experiment-scoped role/host association, source local IDs/locators
Exact participant accession including isoform, taxon/type, biological and experimental role, source order, hosts, detection/type, negative reader value
provenance.interpretation: Qualified xrefs and comments remain auditable provenance statements. Generic see-also, shared method citations, missing annotations or shared participants do not automatically prove study reuse or independence. Reader defaults are not evidence that source markup was explicit.
provenance.audit_status: Potential relationships are listed for review; no automatic connected-component exclusion/final scoring is performed.

parity.reference: Pinned original four development MITAB reader outputs and 18-row ledger, checked by existing load_reference. All14 evidence rows remain expected regardless original human-protein eligibility; eligible4 retain original mask.
parity.unit: Original source artifact SHA + physical row + evidence identifiers; XML record sequence/local ID remains separately locatable.
parity.identity: Exact IntAct interaction ID and typed IMEx identity aliases. Arbitrary generic see-also is not an evidence identity alias. Require one-to-one source-row/XML record mapping; report missing, extra and multiplicity without repair or explosion.
parity.participant_alignment: Match each MITAB A/B primary database+accession to exact XML interactor source primary reference. Preserve XML source order independently. Missing, duplicate/homomer or ambiguous identity is unresolved; never pick convenient orientation.
critical_fields: Exact participant source primary database+accession inclisoform
Participant taxonomy and interaction type IDs
Participant biological/experimental role IDs by exact source identity
Detection method IDs, negative reader value and all experiment host taxids/labels
parity.format_differences: Report n-ary/binary expansion, multiple experiments, source qualifier differences and missing/default values explicitly. Never reinterpret absent MITAB expansion as binary origin. Compare fields available in both formats; do not claim all42columns cross-format lossless.
parity.metrics: All14 row-accounting plus unique evidence-ID bijection; each critical field equal/different/unresolved. Original4eligible reported separately. No tuning, substitution or ranking change from findings.
